## Ownership and acceptance gap

commands split by `--exclude-group=pg` and `--group=pg`. Those commands do not exercise the package

- `packages/tasks-workflow/tests/Pest.php` applies `PgTestCase` to the `Pg` directory;
- `packages/tasks-workflow/tests/Pg/MaterializationPgTest.php` applies `PgTestCase` to the file.

The owning repair must make the root and package entry points agree, rerun the exact package
`composer test` command, and then resume P5.18 from the full joined matrix. P5.18 does not select
the repair because product fixes and changes to P5.13's sealed guidance are outside its scope.
